name: Campaigns exploiting a crisis event with unverified beneficiaries
description: Appeals created immediately after conflict or disaster events with no known organisation behind them and no verifiable delivery route.
fp: May have innocent explanations; assess in context of customer profile and other indicators.

sources.text: FATF, Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment Guidance (2019)
